popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius gives Chalciope the palace scenes that turn the quest: Phrixus' widow pleading with Medea to save her Argonaut sons from Aeëtes' wrath.

popCulture.title: Chalciope
popCulture.description: Aeëtes' elder daughter, wife of Phrixus and sister of Medea — the Colchian mother whose fear for her sons opens Medea's aid to Jason.
